dateRules.dateOnly: YYYY-MM-DD; inclusive endpoints; no UTC date conversion
dateRules.timestamps: ISO 8601 UTC persisted, Asia/Seoul displayed; inputs have explicit +09:00
dateRules.today: calendar date in Asia/Seoul computed on server
dateRules.reviewPeriod: tasks.due_date in inclusive start/end dates; all execution records of those tasks
dateRules.delayed: undeleted, not done, due_date < Seoul today
dateRules.ongoing: ongoing=1 displays 진행 중; when actual_known=0 end_at=start_at is a storage placeholder, not an end time

aggregation.planned: undeleted tasks in selected plan and due-date range
aggregation.blocked: distinct planned tasks with one or more nonblank execution blocked_reason
aggregation.estimated: sum of known estimated_minutes in planned tasks
aggregation.unknown: estimated_known=0 means unset; numeric zero is only a placeholder and is not a user's estimate; display 미정 and disclose omitted count
aggregation.actual: sum actual_minutes only where actual_known=1; design stage durations unknown and excluded; shared period is not counted per stage
aggregation.difference: actual minus known estimated; provisional if unknown estimates exist

idempotency.completion: unique task_id + completion_cycle, database batch; reopening advances cycle; old request key replay cannot recomplete
idempotency.execution: unique request_key and payload match for retries

history: original plan version stored at creation; every successful edit appends a new immutable snapshot with same plan ID; optimistic version check
deletion: tasks soft deleted; excluded from statistics, original records retained in export
export: one JSON file, all six tables including deleted tasks, timestamps, units and timezone
access: anonymous read/write, no login; first-screen public notice required
